buffer_expand_size.docs:
**int**: Number of bytes to expand the output buffer if it is too small to hold the JPEG-encoded image. A value of `0` disables expansion.

*See also: [Camera Encoder](https://esphome.io/components/camera/camera_encoder#configuration-variables)*

buffer_size.docs:
**int**: Initial size of the output buffer in bytes, used to store the JPEG-encoded image data.

*See also: [Camera Encoder](https://esphome.io/components/camera/camera_encoder#configuration-variables)*

quality.docs:
**int**: Sets JPEG compression quality. Valid values range from `1` (lowest quality, highest compression) to `100` (best quality, least compression). Defaults: `80`.

*See also: [Camera Encoder](https://esphome.io/components/camera/camera_encoder#configuration-variables)*
